issue_context.title: nmap_tracker does not fire event anymore when new devices are discovered
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The following automation is not working anymore now that nmap_tracker has been rewrite with config_flow:

```yaml
- alias: Notification - New Device found
  initial_state: true
  trigger:
    - platform: event
      event_type: device_tracker_new_device
  condition: []
  mode: parallel
  action:
    - service: persistent_notification.create
      data:
        title: "New Device found!"
        message: "Home Assistant has discovered a new device: {{ trigger.event.data.entity_id }}"
```

I was using nmap_tracker to only find new devices that connects to my network and not to track them. So new devices were disabled by default but were firing an event.
My yaml config was:
```yaml
device_tracker:
  - platform: nmap_tracker
    hosts: 10.2.10.20-55
    interval_seconds: 15
    consider_home: 120
    new_device_defaults:
      track_new_devices: false
```

Now with the rewrite of the integration: 
- No event is fired when a new device is discovered
- I can't change the scan interval (was set to 15s): now seems to be set to 2min by default
- New devices are enabled by default: should be disabled by default from my point of view (it's a pain to disable devices from this integration one by one, multiple selection of devices is not possible) and a lot of devices are added

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.7.0b0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.6.6

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

nmap_tracker

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://home-assistant.io/integrations/nmap_tracker/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

Some thoughts:

Bring back firing an event when a new device is discovered and maybe add options for:
- being able to change the scan interval
- disable devices when discovered (or disable entities from discovered devices?) (but still fire an event please)

Thank you
comments:
Hey there @bdraco, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`nmap_tracker`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L335) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

> Bring back firing an event when a new device is discovered and maybe add options for:

This was a property of the legacy device trackers: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/device_tracker/legacy.py#L121

Since adding this to the config entry based device trackers would affect all of them (https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/device_tracker/config_entry.py), its not something we can unilaterally do without an architecture discussion.

If this is something you are passionate about, I urge you to start an architecture discussion at https://github.com/home-assistant/architecture/discussions

> being able to change the scan interval
> disable devices when discovered (or disable entities from discovered devices?) (but still fire an event please)

I'll try to get these done before release if I can find the time.

> being able to change the scan interval

Scan interval is now handled globally and should not be configurable by an integration:
<https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/06/02/release-20216/#disable-polling-updates-on-any-integration>

Since https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/06/02/release-20216/#disable-polling-updates-on-any-integration needs `DataUpdateCoordinator`, I will see about reworking `nmap_tracker` to use it and tie in the ability to request manual updates.

> Scan interval is now handled globally and should not be configurable by an integration:
> https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/06/02/release-20216/#disable-polling-updates-on-any-integration

I don't understand how that would work with the nmap_tracker integration: if I disable polling for nmap_tracker, how will it find new devices? 
homeassistant.update_entity need an entity ID so will poll only already discovered entities (found before disabling polling)
In the mean time we can import the value from yaml until we can get the DUC done (breaking change later).

>  if I disable polling for nmap_tracker, how will it find new devices?

Poll any existing one.

> If this is something you are passionate about, I urge you to start an architecture discussion at https://github.com/home-assistant/architecture/discussions

Did it here: https://github.com/home-assistant/architecture/discussions/586
Thank you for your work

review_comments: Why did we add this option? We already have a system level option to disable adding new entities for an integration. We're generally declining this kind of option for device trackers.

It was an intermediate solution during beta.
However, this PR has been reverted (the full nmap tracker modernization has been pulled).
